add.title: Human Rights Violations Against LGBTQI+ People in Angola — Shadow Report 2024 (Angolan CSOs; African Commission 81st session)
add.summary: Thin: the 2024 Angolan CSO shadow report (Arquivo de Identidade Angolano, IRIS Angola, Movimento T, ASTA and others) contains no data on where trans prisoners are housed in Angola — nothing on birth-sex vs identity placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice. Closest documented finding: in June 2024 a transgender woman in Viana (Luanda) was attacked by police officers because of her gender identity, suffered physical injuries, was arbitrarily detained by Esquadra 43 and subjected to degrading treatment, with the case under investigation by the judicial military police of the Provincial Command of Luanda (police custody; no prison placement information). It also notes the 2020 Penal Code criminalises discrimination based on sexual orientation with up to two years' imprisonment.
